'''N'cor Silver''' was an individual that donated 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the [[Lightwind Orphanage]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
N'cor Silver was mentioned in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
